recipe.visualDefinition: A soft-focus outdoor portrait of a blonde woman looking over her shoulder, set against a sun-drenched, blurred natural background with a three-tiered typographic lockup on the right.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject gaze directed toward the viewer from a profile body position
Text block positioned in the upper-right negative space of the background
Warm, golden-hour lighting contrasting with dark clothing
Sharp facial features against a heavily blurred bokeh environment

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the left two-thirds of the frame, medium close-up scale.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes, specifically the one closest to the camera, framed by blonde hair.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, follows the line of the shoulder down, then moves right to the typographic block.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant blurred green and yellow space on the right side used for text placement.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm yellows and greens in the background providing a soft, natural glow.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black of the subject's garment providing a solid base.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep burgundy/red for the script text and subtle makeup tones.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value, low-to-medium saturation background with high contrast on the subject.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Classical serif and formal cursive script
letterConstructionRules: Fluid, connected strokes for the script element
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a rigid, authoritative serif with a soft, personal script.
graphicDevices: Subtle drop shadows for legibility against bright background

candidateDirections.reason: Classical serif feel for the main name
Elegant, flowing script for the secondary title

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a soft-focus portrait of a blonde woman in a black top, looking over her shoulder in a sunlit park with heavy bokeh. The right side should be bright and relatively empty.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add right-aligned text in the upper right quadrant. Use a white serif for the first line, a black serif for the second line, and a burgundy script for the third line.

verificationChecks: Is the subject looking over their shoulder?
Is the background sufficiently blurred to allow text legibility?
Are there three distinct lines of text with varying styles?
Is the lighting warm and natural?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features to avoid likeness
postGenerationChecks: Verify text alignment is flush right
Ensure the bokeh circles are soft and not distracting
Confirm the color palette remains warm and organic
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait subject on left + shallow depth of field + right-aligned triadic typography = Country/Folk album aesthetic.
